name: AtriCure, Inc.
summary: AtriCure, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of devices for surgical ablation of cardiac tissue, exclusion of the left atrial appendage, and temporarily blocking pain by ablating peripheral nerves to medical centers in the United States, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally.
